pick.headline: Konstantin Chernenko dies
pick.summary: On March 10, 1985, Soviet leader Konstantin Chernenko died after thirteen months in office.
pick.significance: He was the third Soviet leader to die in less than three years, clearing the way for a generational change.
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of March 11, 1985, carried Sofia radio interrupting its programming to relay the Soviet announcement that Konstantin Chernenko died on March 10; the OCR of the page is badly broken beyond that.
